app_subtitle:
This tool aggregates trade reports of clients of Ioannis Kantartzis. If you are a client of Kantartzis and you wish to submit your trading report (IBKR activity statement), send it to @optionakias.

Ioannis Kantartzis is not authorized to provide investment advisory services, and there is a standing warning of the Hellenic Capital Market Commission (HCMC) against him, which you can read here.

The warning reads:

Athens, February 24, 2026
ANNOUNCEMENT
The Hellenic Capital Market Commission informs the investing public that Mr. Ioannis Kantartzis, son of Nikolaos, is not permitted to provide investment services, as set out in Sections A and B of Annex I of Law 4514/2018, in financial instruments, as depicted in Section C of Annex I of the same law, and/or to hold client funds. It is also emphasized that pursuant to Law 4514/2018, the provision of investment services and the exercise of investment activities without a license from the Hellenic Capital Market Commission or the corresponding supervisory authority of another member state of the European Union constitutes an offense carrying severe criminal and administrative sanctions. The Hellenic Capital Market Commission draws the attention of investors to evaluating companies (with which they intend to cooperate or are cooperating) regarding their licensing and supervisory status. In particular, they should verify the existence of an operating license for such companies on the website of the Hellenic Capital Market Commission or the corresponding supervisory authorities of other EU member states. In any case, it is highlighted that providing advice for investment in financial instruments, portfolio management, or the reception, transmission, and execution of orders for transactions in financial instruments are indicatively some of the investment services for which authorization from the Hellenic Capital Market Commission or another competent authority is required.

This tool enables potential victims of Kantartzis to see what to expect if they choose to become clients. While nobody can predict the markets—and past performance is not indicative of future returns—what remains constant and certain across these experiences is the high commissions and high transaction frequency, resulting in an enormous drain for the affected accounts. Please be responsible with whom you entrust your capital.
